 View Exterior Photos of the 2027 Hyundai Elantra 
 See the redesigned Elantra’s exterior from every angle.
 By Eric Stafford Published: Nov 19, 2026 shop now Save Hyundai Read the Full Story | View Interior Photos 
 Hyundai has revealed full specs for its freshly designed Elantra compact sedan, and you can get a closer look at its radical styling in the photos below.
 Hyundai The nonhybrid Elantra will debut first for the 2027 model year.
 Hyundai Its standard 2.0-liter inline-four makes 147 horsepower and pairs with a continuously variable automatic transmission.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below Hyundai The new Elantra’s face features distinctive lighting elements and an aggressive-looking front bumper.
 Hyundai The compact sedan’s angular bodywork includes this striking quarter panel.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below Hyundai Hyundai hasn’t yet said how much the 2027 Elantra will cost, but we think it’ll start somewhere around $25,000.
